suggestions.pitch: Sell 34-year-old Keenan Allen at his peak (14.5 a week vs 9.2 projected) plus Vele for 24-year-old Ladd McConkey, who is scoring 16 a week and fits a rebuild.
Juwan Johnson is 30 and scoring 16.1 against a 12 projection, so swap him for 26-year-old Romeo Doubs of similar market value who would start at WR.
Ferguson's value is high at his age, and two young pieces from a contender fit a team out of the race.
